technical_and_design_decisions: All new code will target Spring Framework 6.0+ and Java 17+, aligned with current Spring project requirements.

The integration testing framework for U1 will use JUnit 5, Spring Test, and Hamcrest, with mock message bus implementations instead of real external services (Redis/RabbitMQ) as explicitly required by U1.
The YARN deployment implementation for U2/U8 will extend the existing Spring Cloud Data Flow YARN SPI as a base, rather than building a new YARN integration from scratch.
The migrated Spring XD trigger module (U3) will retain all original functionality with no breaking changes to existing Spring XD trigger interfaces to ensure backward compatibility.
Redis Sentinel support for U4 will leverage the existing Spring Data Redis Sentinel integration, extending the current s-c-s binder rather than building a new Redis client from scratch.
The receptor-client upgrade (U5) will maintain full backward compatibility with existing s-c-s module code that uses the client, only updating internal API calls to match the latest Receptor version.
Admin UI integration (U6) will use the existing publicly available Spring Cloud Data Admin UI client library, with no custom UI development required.

Single node binder auto-configuration (U7) will follow standard Spring Boot auto-configuration conventions, using @ConfigurationProperties for all configurable settings as aligned with U1's configuration testing requirements.

The original Spring XD trigger module source code is publicly available under a license that permits migration to the s-c-s repository without legal restrictions.
Existing s-c-s test suites and CI/CD infrastructure are available and can be extended to cover new functionality, no need to build new test infrastructure from scratch.
